items.title: Ukrainian drones sink Russian warship at naval base in Libya
items.standfirst: Ukraine carried out an attack on a Russian warship moored at a port in Libya, President Volodymyr Zelensky said Monday, claiming that sea drones sank the navy vessel in a surprise assault the previous day. Ukrainian forces deployed seven domestically made sea drones in the operation, which struck what was one of Russia’s newest vessels, commissioned a year after Moscow launched the 2022 full-scale invasion of its neighbour.

items.title: The worst COP ever? Climate talks collapse in chaos
items.standfirst: The COP31 climate talks ended in failure Sunday as a contentious deal collapsed over fossil fuels and the summit in Turkey stretched into record overtime. The final agreement was rejected in a chaotic finale to a UN climate summit that ran two days over schedule, underscoring the strains on diplomacy in an increasingly fractured world. France 24’s Douglas Herbert takes a look at whether the failure to reach an agreement makes COP31 the most disappointing climate summit to date.

items.title: 'Out of control': ICE arrests at Seattle airport spark outcry
items.standfirst: A father and daughter detained by masked ICE officers on an airport jet bridge in Seattle has sparked a renewed outcry over the Trump administration’s immigration policies, with the governor of Washington state calling US federal immigration agents "out of control". Other passengers boarding the Alaska Airlines flight at Seattle-Tacoma International Airport on Saturday used their cellphones to film the father and daughter being detained by the officers, who were wearing unmarked jackets and khaki pants. The recordings were widely viewed on social media.
